title: Existence of the second Adams operation on K_0 of the vector bundles of a scheme, with additivity, pullback compatibility and multiplicativity
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs the second Adams operation on K_0(Vect(X)) from the formula psi^2(E) = [Sym^2(E)] - [wedge^2(E)] and asserts three properties at once: well defined additivity on K_0, compatibility with pullbacks, and multiplicativity (statement lines 12752-12763). The additivity step is not a formal consequence of functoriality, because Sym^2 and wedge^2 are not additive on the nose: the author must compute the graded pieces of the filtrations induced by a two-step filtration on a short exact sequence on both Sym^2(F) and wedge^2(F) and observe that the common term E tensor F cancels (proof lines 12775-12800). The multiplicativity step likewise requires the two non-obvious exact sequences relating Sym^2(E tensor F) and wedge^2(E tensor F) to Sym^2/wedge^2 of the factors, with both maps given on elements (proof lines 12809-12828). The argument uses only standard multilinear algebra and quoted material, so the claim is H2.
